strings.long_src: What number shall I dial?

strings.en_src: She's gone out. Let's hurry to￥Altamira ourselves.
No answer. Could they be out?
strings.long: Нет ответа. Может, их нет дома?

strings.en: Лучше нам больше не лезть в их дела.
strings.en_src: We should stay out of their affairs￥now.

strings.en: Нам ведь ничего не нужно в "Джой￥Дивижн"?
strings.en_src: We don't need anything from Joy￥Division, do we?

strings.long_src: Don't call

strings.en: Какой там номер видеофона у Джейми?
Домашний номер Джейми - в быстром￥наборе ＠赤01＠白.
strings.en_src: Jamie's home number is on speed dial￥＠赤01＠白.

strings.en: Она часто бывает в фармлаборатории￥Нео-Кобе, сохраню и этот номер.
strings.en_src: She's often at Neo Kobe￥Pharmaceutical Lab, so I'll save￥that number too.

strings.en: Вношу фармлабораторию Нео-Кобе в￥быстрый набор ＠赤02＠白.
strings.en_src: Registering Neo Kobe Pharma as￥speed dial ＠赤02＠白.
strings.long_src: I'll put Neo Kobe Pharmaceutical Lab￥on speed dial ＠赤02＠白.

strings.en: Тебе стоит держать связь с Джейми.￥Внесу её номера в быстрый набор.
strings.en_src: You'll want to reach Jamie often, so￥let's set a speed dial.
strings.long_src: You'll want to keep in touch with￥Jamie. I'll put her numbers on speed￥dial.

strings.en: Дом Джейми будет ＠赤01＠白, а￥фармлаборатория Нео-Кобе - ＠赤02＠白.
strings.en_src: I'll save Jamie's home as ＠赤01＠白 and Neo￥Kobe Pharmaceutical Lab as ＠赤02＠白.
Dial 01 for Jamie's home and 02 for￥Neo Kobe Pharmaceutical Lab.￥Remember that.
At this hour Jamie's at the lab.
strings.long_src: Jamie must be at the lab at this￥hour.
strings.long: В это время Джейми наверняка в￥лаборатории.

strings.en: Ты будешь часто ей звонить. Внесу￥номер в быстрый набор.
strings.en_src: You'll be calling her often. I'll￥put it on speed dial.

strings.en: ＠赤Н-не так уж часто я ей звоню!

strings.en_src: It's fine.￥No need to be shy.
strings.long_src: It's all right. No need to be￥embarrassed.

strings.en_src: Registering Jamie's home as speed￥dial ＠赤01＠白.
strings.long_src: I'll put Jamie's home number on￥speed dial ＠赤01＠白.
strings.long: Вношу домашний номер Джейми в￥быстрый набор ＠赤01＠白.

strings.en_src: Don't forget it again. Heh heh.
It's speed dial ＠赤05＠白. Remember that.

strings.long_src: Please try to remember it this time.

strings.en: Ну и память у тебя. Внесу в быстрый￥набор.
strings.en_src: Your memory is terrible. I'll put it￥on speed dial.

strings.en: Номер Наполеона сохранён как ＠赤05＠白. Не￥забывай.
strings.en_src: I've saved Napoleon's number as ＠赤05＠白.￥Don't forget it.

strings.en: Какой номер видеофона был на￥салфетках, что нам дали у￥"Альтамиры"?
strings.en_src: What was the videophone number on￥those tissues we got outside￥Altamira?
What number did they give me￥for the quiz answer?
strings.long_src: What was the videophone number we￥got for answering the quiz￥correctly?
strings.long: Какой номер видеофона нам дали за￥правильный ответ в викторине?

strings.en: Какой номер видеофона был на￥салфетках, что мы нашли у￥"Альтамиры"?
strings.en_src: What was the number on the tissue￥packet picked up outside Altamira?
strings.long_src: What was the videophone number on￥those tissues we found outside￥Altamira?
Old man's house

strings.en: Это номер того старика возле дома￥Ивана.
strings.en_src: The number of the old man￥by Ivan's place.
strings.long_src: That's the number for the old man￥outside Ivan's house.
Oh, it's you. Need some information?
That's right. I need your help.
Password first, all right?
All right. How about the password￥first?
＠赤The revolution is?
＠赤The Hundred Days?
Not even close!
You just repeated it back to me.
What a tired old slogan.
Are you talking about England?
Are you trying to get it wrong?
Don't answer
Oh, right. There was one of those￥too.
Careful you don't catch it.
An annual in the daisy family?
That would be three years.
Look it up in a dictionary.

strings.en_src: You pass...￥The videophone's no good.￥Meet at the usual place!!
strings.long_src: All right, you pass. We can't talk￥on the videophone. Meet me at the￥usual place!
strings.long: Ладно, сойдёт. По видеофону говорить￥нельзя. Встретимся на обычном месте!

strings.en: В этот раз не подведи! Живо сюда!
strings.long_src: Don't stand me up this time! Get￥over here!

strings.en: Тогда пока. Подучись и звони снова!
strings.en_src: ...See you then. So long.￥Go and study up!
strings.long_src: Goodbye, then. Come back when you've￥studied some more!
Gillian, have you forgotten?
The Hundred Days' ＠赤REIGN＠白, remember?
The revolution is ＠赤OVER＠白, remember?

strings.en_src: He hung up. What shall we do?

strings.en: Странно. Я уверен, что номер верный.
strings.en_src: That's strange. I'm sure the number￥is right.
Could the Snatchers have killed￥Napoleon too?

strings.long_src: This is strange! Where did he￥disappear to?

strings.en: Наполеон, может, расшифрует код в￥той медкарте.
strings.long_src: Napoleon might be able to crack the￥code in that medical chart.
I think I've seen it somewhere.

strings.en_src: Where on earth did Napoleon go?

strings.en: Опять этот символ. Что это? Вряд ли￥это символ KTT.
strings.en_src: That symbol again. What is it? I￥don't think it's KTT's.

strings.long_src: A werewolf! Of course!

strings.en: Я знаю, где Наполеон! Ты ведь тоже￥догадался, Гиллиан? Идём к нему.
strings.en_src: I know where Napoleon is! You've￥worked it out too, haven't you,￥Gillian? Let's go see him.

strings.en: Это наверняка послание от Наполеона,￥Гиллиан. Я уверен.
strings.en_src: This must be a message from￥Napoleon, Gillian. I'm sure of it.
The video is a clue to his location.￥Let's hurry there.

strings.en: Я всё ещё не понимаю, о чём ты.
strings.en_src: I still have no idea what you're￥talking about.

strings.en: Оборотень, Гиллиан. Ты ведь его уже￥встречал?
strings.en_src: Gillian, the werewolf.￥You've met him before, no?
strings.long_src: The werewolf, Gillian. You've met￥him before, haven't you?

strings.en_src: The hint is the werewolf.￥You met him recently?
strings.long_src: The werewolf is the clue. We met him￥somewhere before, remember?
strings.long: Подсказка - оборотень. Мы его где-то￥видели, помнишь?

strings.long_src: You know, the werewolf at that place￥that serves whale meat.
strings.long: Ну, оборотень в том месте, где￥подают китовое мясо.

strings.en_src: She's at the lab.￥You spoke on the videophone earlier.
strings.long_src: She's at the lab. We just spoke to￥her on the videophone, remember?
strings.long: Она в лаборатории. Мы же только что￥говорили с ней, помнишь?

strings.en_src: She's at the lab.￥Why not try calling there?
strings.long_src: She's at the lab. Why don't you try￥calling her there?

strings.en: Вот это напугала! Где Джейми￥научилась таким фокусам?
strings.en_src: That scared me! Where did Jamie￥learn a trick like that?
Because I showed her the mask?
strings.long_src: Maybe it's because you showed her￥that mask.
strings.long: Может, потому что ты показал ей ту￥маску.

strings.en: Ту, из "Джой Дивижн"? И всё же шутка￥вышла чересчур.
strings.en_src: The Joy Division one?￥Even so, that joke went far.
strings.long_src: The one from Joy Division? Even so,￥that joke went too far.

strings.en: Может, потому что ты достаёшь её￥звонками.
strings.long_src: Maybe it's because you keep￥pestering her with calls.
What's that supposed to mean,￥Metal?!

strings.en: Нечего смущаться. Джейми полностью￥"снатчнула" твоё сердце.
strings.en_src: No need to be embarrassed. Jamie's￥completely snatched your heart.

strings.long_src: Sorry to bother you at work.

strings.en_src: Make sure you ask Jamie, Gillian.

strings.long_src: I know. About the illegal clinic,￥right?

strings.en_src: I'll hang up now, Jamie. See you.
If I learn of that hospital,￥I'll call.
strings.long_src: I'll call if I find out anything￥about that clinic.
strings.long: Если что-то узнаю про ту клинику -￥позвоню.

strings.long_src: I'm counting on you, Jamie.

strings.en: Я ещё поищу в наших базах про￥больницу "Куин".
strings.en_src: I'll check our records for Queen￥Hospital too.

strings.en: Что такое, Гиллиан? Ты ведь что-то￥хотел?
strings.en_src: What's wrong, Gillian? Didn't you￥want something?
Jamie.￥I can't see you well from here!
strings.long_src: I can't get a good look at you from￥here, Jamie!

strings.en: Не капризничай, Гиллиан. Хотя мне￥немного приятно.
strings.en_src: Gillian... don't be absurd.￥...Though it's rather nice.
strings.long_src: Don't be unreasonable, Gillian.￥Though I'm a little flattered.

strings.en: Что с тобой, Гиллиан? Не унывай.

strings.long_src: We haven't seen each other for a￥while, Jamie.

strings.en: Да. С тех пор, как ты стал￥ДЖАНКЕРом.
strings.en_src: No. Not since before you joined￥JUNKER.

strings.en: Что ты тогда сказал? Я не расслышала￥из-за взлетающего трицикла.
strings.en_src: What did you say back then?￥The tricycle's engine drowned it￥out...
strings.long_src: What did you say that day? I￥couldn't hear over the Tricycle￥taking off.

strings.en_src: Jamie, you look lovely as ever...
strings.long_src: You look as beautiful as ever,￥Jamie.

strings.en: Ох, Гиллиан. Ты всё такой же.
Значит, у нас всё-таки есть общее￥прошлое. Пусть совсем чуть-чуть.
strings.en_src: So we do have a past together. Even￥if it's only a little.
Jamie, that lab coat suits you.
strings.long_src: That lab coat really suits you,￥Jamie.
You think so?

strings.en: У нас нет воспоминаний, Джейми. Но￥мы можем создать новые.
strings.en_src: We don't have memories, Jamie. But￥we can make new ones.
Forget the past we lost.￥Let's build a future together.
strings.long_src: Let's build a future together￥instead of being trapped in a past￥we've lost.
strings.long: Давай строить будущее вместе, а не￥цепляться за потерянное прошлое.

strings.en: Я знаю, что ты прав, но всё ещё не￥могу решиться.
strings.en_src: I know you're right, but I still￥can't make up my mind.
Are we really going to end up apart?
We could still part￥without any hurt, no?
strings.long_src: We can still separate without￥hurting each other, can't we?
strings.long: Сейчас мы ещё можем расстаться, не￥ранив друг друга, правда?

strings.en: Живя без тебя, я кое-что понял,￥Джейми.
strings.long_src: Living apart from you has made me￥realize something, Jamie.

strings.en: Воспоминания о нашей прежней жизни,￥может, не вернутся. Но мои чувства к￥тебе...
strings.en_src: My 'memories of you' from before￥the loss won't return.￥But my feelings for you...
strings.long_src: I may never get back the memories of￥our old life together. But my￥feelings for you...

strings.en: Мои чувства не исчезли. Может, я￥влюбился в тебя заново.
strings.en_src: My feelings for you haven't faded.￥No, perhaps I've begun to love you￥anew.
strings.long_src: My feelings haven't disappeared.￥Maybe I've fallen in love with you￥all over again.
Regardless of who we were in that￥lost past.
strings.long: Неважно, кем мы были в том￥потерянном прошлом.

strings.en: Спасибо, Гиллиан. Ты прав. Нельзя￥вечно оглядываться назад.
strings.en_src: Thank you, Gillian. You're right. We￥can't keep looking back forever.

strings.en: Мы недолго жили вместе, но мне было￥хорошо.
strings.en_src: We didn't live together long, but I￥enjoyed it.

strings.long_src: Even though we were always fighting.

strings.en: Да. Но я скучаю по тем дням.
strings.en_src: Yes. But I miss those days.

strings.long_src: They're the only memories we have.

strings.en: Сначала я сомневался, что справлюсь￥с работой ДЖАНКЕРа.
strings.en_src: At first, I wasn't sure I could￥handle being a JUNKER.

strings.en: Все так чувствуют. Особенно такие,￥как мы, без памяти. Мы не знаем, к￥чему пригодны.
strings.en_src: Everyone does... especially people￥like us, who lost their memories.￥We don't know what suits us.
strings.long_src: Everyone feels that way. Especially￥people like us who've lost their￥memories. We don't know what we're￥suited for.

strings.en_src: Looks like my aptitude test wasn't￥too far off.
strings.long: Похоже, тест на профпригодность не￥сильно ошибся.

strings.en: Опасно, но эта работа помогает мне￥понять, кто я.
strings.en_src: It's dangerous, but this job helps￥me discover who I am.

strings.en: Понимаю. Сам удивляешься своим￥поступкам, и кажется, что увидел￥себя настоящего.
strings.en_src: I see. Your own acts surprise you,￥and you feel you've seen￥your true nature?
strings.long_src: I understand. You surprise yourself￥with what you do, and feel like￥you've seen who you really are.

strings.en: Будто судьба. Я и ДЖАНКЕР. И мы двое￥и снатчеры.
strings.en_src: It feels like fate. Me and JUNKER.￥And the two of us and the Snatchers.

strings.en: Наверняка тут есть связь. Иначе￥зачем нас привезли в Нео-Кобе?
strings.en_src: There must be some connection.￥Otherwise, why would they have￥brought us to Neo Kobe?
But how long will it go on?

strings.long_src: This game of chase with them.
Probably until we recover our￥memories.
strings.long: Наверное, пока к нам не вернётся￥память.

strings.en: Похоже, снатчеры захватили какую-то￥больницу на острове. Мне нужна твоя￥помощь.
strings.en_src: Snatchers seem to have taken over some hospital on the island. About that...￥I need your help.
strings.long_src: The Snatchers seem to have taken￥over a hospital somewhere on the￥island. I need your help with it.

strings.en_src: Anytime, Gillian. If there's￥anything I can do.
strings.long: Всегда пожалуйста, Гиллиан. Если я￥чем-то могу помочь.

strings.en: Попробую что-нибудь разузнать. Это￥может занять время.
strings.en_src: I'll see what I can find out. It￥might take some time.

strings.en: Спрашивай что угодно. С этим я,￥может, помогу.
strings.en_src: Ask me anything. I may be able to￥help with that.
Jamie, that answerphone joke￥went too far!
strings.long_src: That answering machine message went￥too far, Jamie!
Did I scare you?
Were you worried?

strings.en: Не шути так больше. Ты - снатчер...
strings.en_src: No more jokes like that.￥You, a Snatcher...
strings.long_src: Don't ever joke like that again. You￥being a Snatcher...
I don't even want to think about it￥as a joke.
strings.long: Даже в шутку не хочу об этом думать.

strings.en_src: But that mask was really well made.

strings.en: Идею мне подала твоя маска из "Аутер￥Хэвен".
strings.en_src: Gillian had shown me the Outer￥Heaven mask, you see...
strings.long_src: You gave me the idea when you showed￥me your Outer Heaven mask.
Was that one made by Joy Division?
Yes. It belongs to someone at the￥lab.

strings.en_src: No wonder it looked so good.

strings.long_src: I'm sorry about the other day,￥Jamie.
The Chief told me.

strings.en: Но почему ты мне не сказала?
strings.en_src: But why didn't you tell me?

strings.long_src: I'm sorry. I was being childish.

strings.en: Послушай, ты у меня один. Я всегда￥думаю о тебе.
strings.en_src: Listen, there's only you.￥I think of you always.
strings.long_src: Listen, you're the only one for me.￥I'm always thinking of you.

strings.en: Помнишь, я спросил, была ли ты в￥"Альтамире", Джейми?
strings.en_src: Remember when I asked if you'd been￥to Altamira, Jamie?
You said you'd never been there.
strings.long: Ты сказала, что никогда там не была.

strings.long_src: That's right.

strings.en: Я видел, как ты шла с шефом.
strings.en_src: I saw you walking with the Chief.

strings.long_src: It must be some mistake, right?
What?
You must have mistaken someone else￥for me.
strings.long: Ты, наверное, спутал меня с кем-то.

strings.long_src: Someone else?

strings.en_src: Come on, no more gloomy talk?
strings.long_src: Let's stop talking about such gloomy￥things.
Stop prying into my life!
About the photo
There's something I want to ask you.
strings.long: Хочу тебя кое о чём спросить.

strings.en_src: Remember that photo of you I have?
strings.long: Помнишь твою фотографию, что у меня￥есть?

strings.en_src: Oh, the one from when I was a child?

strings.long_src: Where was it taken?

strings.en_src: Who knows... some Olympics,￥by the look of it?
strings.long_src: I'm not sure. It looked like the￥Olympics somewhere.

strings.en: С каких пор она у нас?
strings.en_src: How long have we had it?

strings.en: Думаю, она была у нас, когда нас￥спасли.
strings.en_src: I think we had it when we were￥rescued.
I see. It might be from the Moscow￥Olympics.
Long ago.￥Long before we were born.
strings.long_src: A long time ago. Long before we were￥born.
How could that be?

strings.en_src: It looks like the photo was￥doctored.

strings.long_src: Doctored? By whom? Why?

strings.en_src: I don't know. Maybe we're guinea￥pigs.

strings.long_src: What do you mean?

strings.en: Может, кто-то невидимый дёргает нас￥за ниточки.
strings.en_src: Maybe someone we can't see is￥pulling our strings.

strings.en: Неужели только мы не знаем, кто мы?
strings.en_src: Are we the only ones who don't know￥who we are?

strings.long_src: The government might know something.

strings.en_src: Let's stop. We are who we are.

strings.long_src: Let's think about the future.
Memory

strings.en_src: Any sign of your memory coming back?

strings.en: Может, давным-давно я уже занималась￥такой работой.
strings.en_src: I wonder if I did this kind of work￥long ago.
I feel I wore a lab coat.￥Do you remember, Gillian?
strings.long_src: I have a feeling I wore a lab coat.￥Don't you remember, Gillian?
strings.long: Мне кажется, я носила лабораторный￥халат. Не помнишь, Гиллиан?

strings.en: Ты в халате? Нет, ничего не￥вспоминается.
strings.en_src: Jamie in a lab coat...￥...I remember nothing.
strings.long_src: You in a lab coat? No, it doesn't￥bring anything back.
What about your memory treatment?
I'm still going.
How's it going?

strings.en: Иногда что-то смутно мелькает. Но￥стоит попытаться вспомнить -￥исчезает.
strings.en_src: Sometimes I catch a faint glimpse.￥But it disappears when I try to￥remember.

strings.en: Похоже, остаётся ждать, пока она￥вернётся сама.
strings.en_src: With this, it seems...￥you just have to wait.
strings.long_src: It seems we just have to wait for it￥to come back on its own.

strings.en: Снатчерам нужна больница с￥оборудованием для УФ-терапии. Не￥знаешь такой?
strings.en_src: A Snatcher would need a hospital￥with UV therapy equipment. Know of￥any?
strings.long_src: The Snatchers need a hospital with￥ultraviolet treatment equipment. Do￥you know any?

strings.en_src: UV therapy clinics aren't rare.￥But we keep records with the￥island's clinics. I'll look.
strings.long_src: Quite a few hospitals have that￥equipment. We have business records￥for hospitals on the island, so I'll￥check.
strings.long: Такое оборудование есть во многих￥больницах. У нас есть бухгалтерия по￥больницам острова, я проверю.

strings.en_src: ...Don't expect much though.￥A back-alley clinic making its￥own drugs, I can't trace.
strings.long_src: But don't get your hopes up. If it's￥an illegal clinic that develops its￥own drugs, I can't help.
strings.long: Только не обнадёживайся. Если это￥подпольная клиника со своими￥лекарствами, я бессильна.

strings.en_src: I'll call if I find anything,￥Gillian.
Don't worry. I'll call if I find￥anything.
Now I've a reason to talk to you.
strings.long_src: Now I have another excuse to talk to￥you.
strings.long: Теперь у меня есть ещё один повод￥тебе позвонить.

strings.en_src: Silly. You don't need to worry about￥that.

strings.long_src: Oleen Hospital

strings.en: Больница "Олин"? Та, что для собак и￥кошек? Это вполне законная￥ветеринарная клиника.
strings.en_src: Oleen Hospital? Ah, the cat and dog￥place? Should be a proper￥animal clinic, honest.
strings.long_src: Oleen Hospital? The one for dogs and￥cats? It should be a perfectly￥legitimate veterinary hospital.

strings.en_src: I don't think Oleen relates￥to Snatchers.
strings.long_src: I don't think Oleen Hospital has￥anything to do with the Snatchers.
strings.long: Не думаю, что больница "Олин" как-то￥связана со снатчерами.

strings.long_src: Queen Hospital

strings.en_src: Queen Hospital? Wait, I'll check the￥records. Here it is!
...Queen Hospital. Oct to Dec￥they ordered anticancer￥drugs in bulk.
strings.long_src: Queen Hospital. They've ordered huge￥amounts of cancer drugs from October￥through December.
strings.long: Больница "Куин". С октября по￥декабрь заказали огромное количество￥противораковых препаратов.

strings.long_src: Cancer drugs? Just as I thought.
That settles it.
The director is Chin Shu Ho. He's￥Chinese.

strings.en: Меня тревожит этот огромный заказ￥противораковых. Будь осторожен.
strings.en_src: That unusually large order of cancer￥drugs worries me. Be careful.
Our records don't have any more￥details.
What sort of man is Chin?
strings.long_src: What kind of man is Chin Shu Ho?
strings.long: Что за человек этот Чин Шу Хо?

strings.en: Никогда о нём не слышала, и записей￥нет. Может, врач без лицензии.
strings.en_src: A name I've never heard.￥...No data either.￥An unlicensed back-alley doctor?
strings.long_src: I've never heard of him, and we have￥no records. Maybe he's an unlicensed￥doctor.
Yes. He's quite a criminal.

strings.en_src: A record, and his licence revoked.￥The city is full of such doctors.
strings.long_src: So he lost his medical license￥because of his criminal record.￥There are many illegal doctors like￥that in the city.
strings.long: Значит, лишился лицензии из-за￥судимости. Таких подпольных врачей в￥городе много.

strings.en_src: Why don't you check JUNKER's￥records? You might find something.

strings.en: Я тоже поищу в нашей базе.

strings.long_src: Dream
Are you still having that dream,￥Jamie?
strings.long: Тебе всё ещё снится тот сон, Джейми?
Да. В последнее время каждый день.

strings.en_src: A meaningful dream?￥What does the counselor say?
strings.long_src: It sounds like it means something.￥What does your counselor say?
strings.long: Похоже, он что-то значит. Что￥говорит твой психолог?

strings.en: Мне страшно. Лучше бы память вообще￥не возвращалась.
strings.en_src: I'm scared. I'd rather my memories￥never came back.

strings.en: Может, и нам с тобой лучше оставить￥всё как есть.
strings.en_src: Maybe our relationship would be￥better off staying as it is too.

strings.long_src: We can't just leave things like￥this.
What do you mean?

strings.en: А что, если мы были врагами?
Ты мне дорог. Но не из-за нашего￥прошлого.
strings.en_src: I care about you. But it's not￥because of our past.

strings.long_src: I feel the same way.

strings.en_src: Then why can't we stay as we are?
strings.long: Тогда почему бы не оставить всё как￥есть?

strings.en_src: All right.￥Let's take it as it comes.
strings.long_src: All right. Let's live our lives￥without forcing things.
But that dream will torment me again￥tonight.
strings.long: Но этой ночью тот сон снова будет￥меня мучить.

strings.en_src: Jamie, it's not just you. Me too...
strings.long_src: You're not alone, Jamie. I have my￥dreams too.
strings.long: Ты не одна, Джейми. Мне тоже снятся￥сны.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда на￥ужин.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to dinner lately.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to dinner￥the other day.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда на￥мюзикл.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the musical recently.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥musical the other day.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда в￥зоопарк.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the zoo recently.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the zoo￥the other day.

strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the park lately.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥amusement park the other day.
strings.long: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда в￥парк аттракционов.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда на￥пляж.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the sea.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥beach the other day.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда на￥скачки.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the race lately.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥races the other day.
Thank you for inviting me out for a￥drink the other day.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда в￥игровой зал.
strings.en_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥arcade the other day.

strings.en: Спасибо, что позвал меня тогда в￥аквариум.
strings.en_src: ...Thank you for asking me￥to the aquarium.
strings.long_src: Thank you for inviting me to the￥aquarium the other day.

strings.en: Я не смогла пойти, но мне было￥приятно.
strings.en_src: I couldn't go, but it was nice to be￥asked.
strings.long_src: I couldn't go, but the thought made￥me happy.
If we don't meet now, we may never￥get another chance.
strings.long: Если не встретимся сейчас, другого￥шанса может не быть.

strings.en_src: Don't say sad things.￥It's hard for me too...
strings.long_src: Don't say such sad things. This is￥hard for me too.
strings.long: Не говори таких грустных вещей. Мне￥тоже тяжело.

strings.en: Я хочу увидеться и поговорить￥вживую, Джейми.
strings.en_src: I want to see you and talk in￥person, Jamie.

strings.en: Я всегда думаю о тебе, Гиллиан. Но￥лучше нам не встречаться.
strings.en_src: I'm always thinking of you, Gillian.￥But it's better if we don't meet.

strings.long_src: We'd only misunderstand each other￥again.
strings.long: Мы снова друг друга не поймём.

strings.en_src: It hurts to see you. This is better.
We can't meet... not as we are.
strings.long_src: We can't see each other while things￥are like this.
strings.long: Пока всё так, нам нельзя видеться.

strings.en_src: Is that your JUNKER ID? It's￥surprisingly stylish.
Gillian, I'm glad.￥Now you have proof of who you are...
strings.long_src: I'm glad you have something to prove￥who you are now, Gillian.
strings.long: Я рада, что теперь тебе есть чем￥подтвердить, кто ты, Гиллиан.

strings.en: О деньгах не волнуйся. У меня есть￥работа.
strings.en_src: Don't worry about money. I have my￥job.
So you're paid properly.￥...That's a relief.
strings.long_src: I'm relieved to hear you're getting￥paid properly.
Candy
What's that candy?

strings.en_src: A keepsake of Gibson, my￥partner to be.
strings.long_src: It belonged to Gibson. He was￥supposed to be my colleague.
strings.long: Она принадлежала Гибсону. Он должен￥был стать моим напарником.

strings.long_src: That candy?

strings.en_src: He gave it to orphans, I hear.
strings.long_src: They say he handed it out to￥children at an orphanage.
strings.long: Говорят, он раздавал их детям в￥приюте.

strings.long_src: He must have been a kind man.
Chess piece

strings.en: Это ведь шахматная фигура? Что с￥ней?
strings.long_src: That's a chess piece, isn't it?￥What's wrong?
Medical chart

strings.en: Это из больницы "Куин", о которой я￥говорил.
strings.en_src: This came from Queen Hospital, the￥place I told you about.

strings.en: Это из больницы "Куин". Похоже,￥снатчеры проходят там￥техобслуживание.
strings.en_src: This came from Queen Hospital. We￥think the Snatchers go there for￥maintenance.

strings.long_src: Can you make anything of it?

strings.en: Похоже на медкарту. Это по-китайски?￥Не могу прочесть. Подпольные врачи￥шифруют записи на всякий случай.￥Может, это оно.
strings.en_src: A medical chart, perhaps...?￥This is Chinese, isn't it?￥I can't read it...￥Back-alley doctors write in code for￥safety. Isn't this the same?
strings.long_src: It looks like a medical chart. Is￥this Chinese? I can't read it.￥Illegal doctors use codes to protect￥themselves. Maybe that's what this￥is.

strings.en: По-китайски? Точно! Наполеон -￥китаец! Он может понять.
strings.en_src: Chinese? Of course! Napoleon's￥Chinese! He might understand it.
These five characters are the￥patient's name, surely? Ask￥someone who knows Chinese.
strings.long_src: Those five characters must be the￥patient's name. Someone who knows￥Chinese might be able to read them.
strings.long: Эти пять иероглифов - наверняка имя￥пациента. Кто-нибудь со знанием￥китайского прочтёт.

strings.long_src: Matches

strings.en_src: No, these are needed for the case.
strings.long_src: No. I need these for the￥investigation.

strings.en: Понятно. Сейчас ведь мало кто курит?
strings.en_src: I see. Not many people smoke these￥days, do they?
Smoking is bad for you, Gillian.￥Don't ever start.

strings.en: Не волнуйся. Я всё время жую жвачку.
strings.en_src: Don't worry. I'm always chewing gum.
JUNKER issues us gum with adrenaline￥in it.

strings.en: OLEEN? Никогда не слышала. Это на￥нашем острове?
strings.en_src: OLEEN? I've never heard of it. Is it￥on this island?
Almost all drug work on the￥island is done here...
strings.long_src: We handle most of the island's drug￥development and management here.
strings.long: Почти вся разработка и учёт лекарств￥на острове идёт через нас.

strings.en_src: I don't know any hospital called￥OLEEN.

strings.long_src: Temple
A palace. Where could it be?
strings.long: Дворец. Где бы это могло быть?

strings.long_src: It looks like a palace somewhere far￥away.
The call won't go through.

strings.en_src: The line seems to be busy.
